# insert

> Immutably insert a value into an array at a path in a document using structural sharing.

<!-- Section to include introductory text. Make sure to keep an empty line after the intro `section` element and another before the `/section` close. -->

<section class="intro">

This function immutably inserts a value into an array at a specified path in a document. Only objects and arrays along the path are shallow-cloned; all other subtrees retain their original references (structural sharing).

</section>

<!-- /.intro -->

<!-- Package usage documentation. -->

<section class="usage">

## Usage

```javascript
var insert = require( '@stdlib/utils/json-patch/base/insert' );
```

#### insert( document, tokens, value )

Immutably inserts a value into an array at a path in a document using structural sharing.

```javascript
var doc = {
    'a': [ 1, 2, 3 ]
};
var out = insert( doc, [ 'a', '1' ], 99 );
// returns { 'a': [ 1, 99, 2, 3 ] }

var bool = ( doc.a === out.a );
// returns false

bool = ( doc === out );
// returns false
```

The `-` token is resolved to the array length, appending the value to the end of the array.

```javascript
var doc = [ 1, 2, 3 ];
var out = insert( doc, [ '-' ], 4 );
// returns [ 1, 2, 3, 4 ]
```

</section>

<!-- /.usage -->

<!-- Package usage notes. Make sure to keep an empty line after the `section` element and another before the `/section` close. -->

<section class="notes">

## Notes

-   Only objects and arrays along the path are shallow-cloned. All other subtrees keep their original references (structural sharing).
-   The final container must be an array. The value is inserted before the given index via `splice( index, 0, value )`, shifting existing elements right.
-   The `-` token is resolved to `array.length` (append).
-   The function throws an `Error` if any token is an unsafe value (e.g., `__proto__`, `constructor`).
-   The function throws a `TypeError` if an intermediate path segment references a non-traversable value (e.g., a string or number).

</section>

<!-- /.notes -->

<!-- Package usage examples. -->

<section class="examples">

## Examples

<!-- eslint no-undef: "error" -->

```javascript
var insert = require( '@stdlib/utils/json-patch/base/insert' );

// Insert an element into an array:
var doc = [ 1, 2, 3 ];
var out = insert( doc, [ '1' ], 99 );
console.log( out );
// => [ 1, 99, 2, 3 ]

// Append an element to an array:
doc = [ 1, 2, 3 ];
out = insert( doc, [ '-' ], 4 );
console.log( out );
// => [ 1, 2, 3, 4 ]

// Insert into a nested array:
doc = {
    'a': {
        'b': [ 1, 2 ]
    }
};
out = insert( doc, [ 'a', 'b', '1' ], 42 );
console.log( out );
/* =>
    {
        'a': {
            'b': [ 1, 42, 2 ]
        }
    }
*/

// Structural sharing (unchanged subtrees keep references):
doc = {
    'a': {
        'b': [ 1, 2 ]
    },
    'c': {
        'd': 3
    }
};
out = insert( doc, [ 'a', 'b', '0' ], 99 );
console.log( out.c === doc.c );
// => true
```

</section>

<!-- /.examples -->
